summary: Implemented `Perc` in `seaborn._stats.order`, exported it through `seaborn.objects`, documented its API and examples, added the v0.12.1 release note, and added focused tests. Focused tests passed (6); the full suite reported 1,785 passed, 81 skipped, and 6 xfailed, with one unrelated existing failure in `tests/test_axisgrid.py::TestFacetGrid::test_subplot_kws` due to the installed Matplotlib axis class name. No packages were installed.
